                         d(CoverManager.class.getSimpleName(),
                                 "Cover downloaded for " + coverInfo.getAlbum() + " from " + url
                                         + ", size=" + coverBytes.length);
+                    break;
                 }
             } catch (Exception e) {
                 w(CoverManager.class.getSimpleName(), "Cover get bytes failure : " + e);

Root cause: The bug was caused by a missing `break` statement in a switch-case or loop structure within the `CoverManager` class. This omission likely led to unintended fall-through behavior, causing the program to continue executing subsequent cases or statements even after a match was found, which could result in incorrect handling of cover art retrieval. The patch adds the necessary `break` to prevent this unintended behavior.
